claims.statement: Export guide covers FPT/GHEC/GHES and says people with project access can export a view. It does not require admin/write explicitly or prove actual target access and private item permissions.

Export downloads a view as tab-separated TSV, not a declared full project snapshot. Source does not specify all fields, archived items, hidden/private items or filter behavior; do not certify exhaustive backup from this procedure.

Repository Projects navigation and view menu lead to Export view data; a downloaded file alone does not prove complete integrity, portable restoration, automation/access preservation or native recovery.

Project/repository permissions still govern visible items; export capability is separate from authorization to redistribute private draft, field or repository data. No private export or external transfer performed.

Source does not define sanitization against spreadsheet formula interpretation or TSV escaping/schema guarantees. These remain proposed implementation checks, not tested upstream vulnerabilities or certified safe handling.
Linked access/visibility pages are separate reference evidence. All claims reference-only; no export receipt, accepted policy, rights clearance or native rollout certified.
